check_connection.title: Check connection
check_connection.description: Confirm the API key works by looking up the location of one IP address with the IP Lookup API, the catalogue verification endpoint. Returns the location record; a 401 means the key is wrong.

address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

output.description: Location data for the IP: is_valid, country, region, city, lat, lon, timezone, isp.

get_balance_sheet.title: Get balance sheet data for a specific company, period, and year
get_balance_sheet.description: Returns balance sheet data from SEC 10-Q and 10-K filings for one company, fiscal period and year. Requires `ticker` or `cik`. For which periods exist use get_balance_sheet_availability.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., ADBE). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 796343). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

period.description: Fiscal period. Must be one of: q1, q2, q3, q4, or fy (full year). If set, year must also be set.

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g., 2025). Must be a valid year after 2000. Historical data before the previous year requires a premium subscription. If set, period must also be set.

output.description: Get balance sheet data for a specific company, period, and year: the JSON response.

get_balance_sheet_availability.title: List which fiscal periods have balance sheet data for a company (premium)
get_balance_sheet_availability.description: Returns the fiscal years and quarters for which balance sheet data is available for a company. Requires a premium subscription (Developer tier and above).
get_balance_sheet_availability.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., ADBE). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 796343). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

output.description: List which fiscal periods have balance sheet data for a company (premium): the JSON response.

get_bank_holidays.title: Get bank holidays for a given country and year
get_bank_holidays.description: Returns bank holidays for a country and calendar year, covering banking closures only. Requires a `country`. To test a single date use is_bank_holiday.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-2 country code (preferred).

year.description: Calendar year between 1980 and 2050 (inclusive). Defaults to the current year. Premium only.

output.description: A list of bank holiday entries for the specified country and year. Each entry contains the holiday name, date, day of the week, and country information.

is_bank_holiday.title: Check if a specific date is a bank holiday for a given country
is_bank_holiday.description: Checks whether a given date is a bank holiday in a country. Requires `date` and `country`. For a whole year's calendar use get_bank_holidays.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2025-12-25). Note: dates in future calendar years are for premium subscribers only.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-2 country code (preferred).

output.description: An object indicating whether the given date is a bank holiday in the specified country.

bin_lookup.title: Lookup bank information by BIN
bin_lookup.description: Returns bank and issuer information for a Bank Identification Number. Requires a `bin`, typically the first 6-8 digits of a credit card number.

bin.description: The Bank Identification Number (BIN) to look up. This is typically the first 6-8 digits of a credit card number.

output.description: Lookup bank information by BIN: the JSON response.

get_bitcoin_data.title: Get the latest Bitcoin price and market data
get_bitcoin_data.description: Returns the latest Bitcoin price and market data. Takes no parameters. For a price series over a past time range use get_bitcoin_historical_data.

output.description: Get the latest Bitcoin price and market data: the JSON response.

get_bitcoin_historical_data.title: Get historical Bitcoin price data
get_bitcoin_historical_data.description: Returns historical Bitcoin price data over a chosen interval and Unix timestamp range. For the latest price instead use get_bitcoin_data.

start.description: Start timestamp in Unix format (in seconds).

end.description: End timestamp in Unix format (in seconds).

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return.

output.description: Get historical Bitcoin price data: the JSON response.

get_bitcoin_treasury.title: Get SEC-reported bitcoin holdings of companies and ETFs
get_bitcoin_treasury.description: Bitcoin positions reported to the SEC in quarterly XBRL filings, covering operating companies and spot bitcoin exchange-traded products. Coverage is limited to SEC filers (holders listed only outside the US are not included), and each position is as of the filer's reported period end. For holdings in other crypto assets use get_crypto_treasury.

ticker.description: Stock ticker of the filer, e.g. MSTR. Private filers have no ticker; use cik.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the filer, with or without leading zeros.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the filer name. Requires a Business or Professional subscription.

entity_type.description: OPERATING is a company holding crypto on its balance sheet. ETP is an exchange-traded product whose holdings are the fund itself. PRIVATE is a filer with no listed ticker.

period.description: Reporting period end as YYYY-MM-DD, or 'latest'. Defaults to the most recent period. History depth is limited by subscription tier.

include_unverified.description: Include positions whose unit count does not reconcile with the filer's own reported fair value. Excluded by default; when included they are reproduced exactly as filed and carry a warning.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Capped by tier: 5 on Free, 50 on Developer, 250 on Business and Professional.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination.

output.description: Get SEC-reported bitcoin holdings of companies and ETFs: the JSON response.

get_bsb_info.title: Get Australian Bank Branch Information by BSB Number
get_bsb_info.description: Looks up the bank, branch, address and supported payment systems for a 6-digit Australian BSB number. Requires `bsb`. To find a BSB by bank or location use search_bsb.

bsb.description: The 6-digit Australian BSB number, with or without a hyphen (e.g. 062-000 or 062000).

output.description: Get Australian Bank Branch Information by BSB Number: the JSON response.

search_bsb.title: Search for Australian Bank Branches and BSB Numbers
search_bsb.description: Finds Australian bank branches and their BSB numbers by bank name, suburb, state or postcode. To look up a single BSB number already known use get_bsb_info.

bank_name.description: Bank name to search for. At least one of bank_name, suburb, state, or postcode is required. Premium only.

suburb.description: Suburb to search for branches. Premium only.

state.description: Australian state or territory code (e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD). Premium only.

postcode.description: 4-digit Australian postcode to search for branches. Premium only.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Available for annual subscriptions only.

output.description: Search for Australian Bank Branches and BSB Numbers: the JSON response.

get_canada_routing_number_info.title: Get Canadian Bank Branch Information by Routing Number
get_canada_routing_number_info.description: Returns the Canadian bank branch for a 9-digit EFT `routing_number`, or for a `transit_number` plus `institution_number`. To search by name or location use search_canada_routing_numbers.

routing_number.description: The 9-digit Canadian routing number in EFT format (0AAATTTTT). At least one of routing_number, or both transit_number and institution_number together, must be set.

transit_number.description: The 5-digit branch transit number. Must be used together with institution_number.

institution_number.description: The 3-digit financial institution number. Must be used together with transit_number.

output.description: Get Canadian Bank Branch Information by Routing Number: the JSON response.

search_canada_routing_numbers.title: Search for Canadian Banks and Routing Numbers
search_canada_routing_numbers.description: Finds Canadian bank branches and their routing numbers by bank name, city, province or postal code. To decode a known routing number use get_canada_routing_number_info. Requires a premium subscription.
search_canada_routing_numbers.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

bank_name.description: Bank name to search for. At least one of bank_name, city, province, or postal_code is required. Premium only.

city.description: City name to search for branches. Premium only.

province.description: Two-letter province or territory code (e.g. ON, QC, BC). Premium only.

postal_code.description: Postal code to search for branches. Premium only.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Available for annual subscriptions only.

output.description: Search for Canadian Banks and Routing Numbers: the JSON response.

get_cash_flow.title: Get cash flow statement data for a specific company, period, and year
get_cash_flow.description: Returns cash flow statement data from SEC 10-Q and 10-K filings for one company, fiscal period and year. Requires `ticker` or `cik`. For available periods use get_cash_flow_availability.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., ADBE). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 796343). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

period.description: Fiscal period. Must be one of: q1, q2, q3, q4, or fy (full year). If set, year must also be set.

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g., 2025). Must be a valid year after 2000. Historical data before the previous year requires a premium subscription. If set, period must also be set.

output.description: Get cash flow statement data for a specific company, period, and year: the JSON response.

get_cash_flow_availability.title: List which fiscal periods have cash flow data for a company (premium)
get_cash_flow_availability.description: Returns the fiscal years and quarters for which cash flow data is available for a company. Requires a premium subscription (Developer tier and above).
get_cash_flow_availability.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., ADBE). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 796343). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

output.description: List which fiscal periods have cash flow data for a company (premium): the JSON response.

get_current_commodity_price.title: Get current commodity price (single or batch)
get_current_commodity_price.description: Returns the current price for a single commodity (when `name` is provided) or a list of commodities (when `names` is provided). Optional `currency` and `unit` parameters convert the response from the native USD/USX quote into any supported currency and unit.

name.description: Name of a single commodity. Mutually exclusive with `names`.

names.description: Comma-separated list of commodity values for a batch request (max 30). Mutually exclusive with `name`. Available to Business, Professional, and Enterprise subscribers, or any annual plan; other tiers should use the `name` parameter for single-commodity lookups.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code to convert the price into (e.g., EUR, GBP, INR). When provided, USX prices are first normalized to USD before conversion. Defaults to the native USD/USX quote.

unit.description: Target mass/volume/energy unit to convert the price into (e.g., kg, g, lb, metric_ton, liter). Bushel and board_feet are commodity-specific and cannot be cross-converted.

output.description: Get current commodity price (single or batch): the JSON response.

get_historical_commodity_price.title: Get historical commodity prices
get_historical_commodity_price.description: Returns a historical price series for a commodity over an optional Unix start/end range and interval. Requires a `name`. For the latest price use get_current_commodity_price.

name.description: Name of commodity.

output.description: Get historical commodity prices: the JSON response.

get_commodity_snapshot.title: Get current prices for all supported commodities in a single call
get_commodity_snapshot.description: Returns an enriched price object for all 30 supported commodities on every plan, including the free tier. Free responses carry the last completed daily settlement; premium plans return the live price. Optional filters narrow the result set.
get_commodity_snapshot.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

category.description: Filter to a single product category.

exchange.description: Filter to commodities listed on a single exchange.

output.description: Get current prices for all supported commodities in a single call: the JSON response.

get_commodity_contract.title: Get price information for a specific commodity contract
get_commodity_contract.description: Returns price information for a specific commodity contract or all contracts matching a commodity root. Either symbol or symbol_root must be provided, but not both.

symbol.description: Specific contract symbol to look up (e.g., GCK26).

symbol_root.description: Commodity root to filter contracts (e.g., GC returns all contracts starting with GC like GCK26, GCM26, etc.).

output.description: Get price information for a specific commodity contract: the JSON response.

get_commodity_contract_list.title: Get a list of all available commodity contracts
get_commodity_contract_list.description: Returns a list of all available commodity contracts with their symbols and commodity names. This endpoint is useful for discovering which contracts are available for querying.

output.description: Get a list of all available commodity contracts: the JSON response.

get_commodity_forward_curve.title: Get the forward curve (all active contracts) for a commodity
get_commodity_forward_curve.description: Returns every active futures contract for the requested commodity, sorted by contract month, along with a contango/backwardation classification and 1-month and ~12-month percent slopes. Reserved for Business, Professional, and annual-subscription tiers.
get_commodity_forward_curve.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

name.description: Commodity value. Same set as the `get_current_commodity_price` `name` parameter.

output.description: Get the forward curve (all active contracts) for a commodity: the JSON response.

convert_currency.title: Converts an existing currency and amount into a new currency
convert_currency.description: Converts an `amount` from one currency to another. Requires `have`, `want` and `amount`. For the raw rate without converting a figure use get_exchange_rate.

have.description: Currency you currently hold. Must be 3-character currency code (e.g. USD).

want.description: Currency you want to convert to. Must be 3-character currency code (e.g. USD).

output.description: Converts an existing currency and amount into a new currency: the JSON response.

get_crypto_price_historical.title: Get historical OHLCV data for a cryptocurrency
get_crypto_price_historical.description: Returns historical OHLCV candles for a cryptocurrency at a chosen interval and time range. Requires a `symbol` such as ETHUSDT. For the live price use get_crypto_price.

interval.description: Time interval between data points. Default is 1h.

start.description: Start timestamp in Unix seconds. If omitted, the most recent `limit` data points are returned.

end.description: End timestamp in Unix seconds. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return. Default 100, maximum 1000.

output.description: Get historical OHLCV data for a cryptocurrency: the JSON response.

get_crypto_price.title: Get current price of a cryptocurrency
get_crypto_price.description: Returns the current market price of a cryptocurrency. Requires a `symbol` such as ETHUSDT. For past prices and OHLCV candles use get_crypto_price_historical.

symbol.description: Cryptocurrency symbol (e.g. ETHUSDT). To get the full list of available symbols, use the Crypto Symbols API.

output.description: Get current price of a cryptocurrency: the JSON response.

get_crypto_treasury.title: Get SEC-reported corporate crypto treasury holdings
get_crypto_treasury.description: Crypto asset positions reported to the SEC in quarterly XBRL filings. Coverage is limited to SEC filers (holders listed only outside the US are not included), and each position is as of the filer's reported period end. With no parameters, returns the largest current positions ranked by dollar value. Positions whose unit count does not reconcile with the filer's own fair value are excluded unless include_unverified is set.

ticker.description: Stock ticker of the filer, e.g. MSTR. Private filers have no ticker; use cik.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the filer, with or without leading zeros.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the filer name. Requires a Business or Professional subscription.

asset.description: Restrict to one crypto asset. UNKNOWN returns positions whose asset the filing did not state and which could not be identified.

entity_type.description: OPERATING is a company holding crypto on its balance sheet. ETP is an exchange-traded product whose holdings are the fund itself. PRIVATE is a filer with no listed ticker.

period.description: Reporting period end as YYYY-MM-DD, or 'latest'. Defaults to the most recent period. History depth is limited by subscription tier.

include_unverified.description: Include positions whose unit count does not reconcile with the filer's own reported fair value. Excluded by default; when included they are reproduced exactly as filed and carry a warning.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Capped by tier: 5 on Free, 50 on Developer, 250 on Business and Professional.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination.

output.description: Get SEC-reported corporate crypto treasury holdings: the JSON response.

get_crypto_symbols.title: Retrieve cryptocurrency symbols
get_crypto_symbols.description: Returns the list of cryptocurrency ticker symbols available. Use it to find valid symbols before requesting quotes from the Crypto Price API.

output.description: A list of available cryptocurrency symbols.

get_currency_volatility.title: Get currency volatility
get_currency_volatility.description: Returns the latest realised volatility for a currency `pair`, with optional `window`, `method` and annualisation. For a time series use get_currency_volatility_historical.

pair.description: Currency pair in ABC_DEF form (e.g. EUR_USD). Both must be supported fiat currency codes; ZWG, BTC, and XAG are not supported.

window.description: Lookback window for realized volatility, in trading days. Defaults to 30. Must be between 2 and 1000.

day_count.description: Annualization factor: 252 trading days (default) or 365 calendar days.

annualized.description: Whether to treat the annualized figure as the headline value. Defaults to true.

output.description: Latest realized volatility, volatility cone, and percentile context for a currency pair: the JSON response.

get_currency_volatility_historical.title: Historical time series of rolling volatility for a currency pair
get_currency_volatility_historical.description: Returns a realised volatility time series for a currency `pair` across a date range or `days` lookback. For the latest single value use get_currency_volatility.

pair.description: Currency pair in ABC_DEF form (e.g. EUR_USD). Both must be supported fiat currency codes; ZWG, BTC, and XAG are not supported.

window.description: Lookback window for realized volatility, in trading days. Defaults to 30. Must be between 2 and 1000.

days.description: Length of the trailing date range in calendar days, ending today. Defaults to 90. Maximum 1825. Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a range query. Use with end_date instead of days.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a range query. Use with start_date instead of days.

day_count.description: Annualization factor: 252 trading days (default) or 365 calendar days.

annualized.description: Whether to treat the annualized figure as the headline value. Defaults to true.

output.description: Historical time series of rolling volatility for a currency pair: the JSON response.

get_currency_volatility_forecast.title: EWMA and GARCH(1,1) volatility forecasts for a currency pair
get_currency_volatility_forecast.description: Projects forward volatility for a currency `pair` over a `horizon`, using EWMA or a comparable `method`. For realised values instead use get_currency_volatility.

pair.description: Currency pair in ABC_DEF form (e.g. EUR_USD). Both must be supported fiat currency codes; ZWG, BTC, and XAG are not supported.

method.description: Forecast method: garch_11 (default) or ewma. If a GARCH fit does not converge the response falls back to EWMA.

lambda.description: EWMA decay factor (only used when method=ewma). Defaults to 0.94. Must be between 0.80 and 0.99.

horizon.description: Comma-separated forecast horizons in trading days (e.g. 1,5,21,63). Defaults to 1,5,21,63.

day_count.description: Annualization factor: 252 trading days (default) or 365 calendar days.

output.description: EWMA and GARCH(1,1) volatility forecasts for a currency pair: the JSON response.

get_earnings_calendar.title: Get earnings results and upcoming dates
get_earnings_calendar.description: Returns earnings reports for one company (`ticker`), one calendar date (`date`), or a date range (`date_start`/`date_end`). At least one of these is required, and `date` cannot be combined with a range. Covers 50,000+ tickers on US and international exchanges with history back to 2000. Results are sorted by date (newest first) and returned 50 per request; use `offset` to page. Past reports only by default; set `show_upcoming=true` (premium) to include scheduled future reports. EPS and revenue are in the company's reporting currency. `actual_eps`/`estimated_eps` are on the adjusted (non-GAAP) basis analysts use; `actual_eps_gaap` is GAAP diluted EPS from the SEC 10-Q/10-K (US SEC filers). For upcoming dates filtered by exchange use get_upcoming_earnings.
get_earnings_calendar.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g. MSFT, 7203.T). Returns that company's earnings reports, newest first.

date.description: Single report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-07-30). Returns every company reporting on that date. Cannot be combined with date_start or date_end.

date_start.description: Start of a report-date range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). If date_end is omitted, the range ends 7 days after date_start.

date_end.description: End of a report-date range (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Must be on or after date_start. If date_start is omitted, the range starts 7 days before date_end.

show_upcoming.description: Include scheduled future reports (dates after today). Without it only past and same-day reports are returned. Premium only: free-tier requests that pass this parameter are rejected.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination. Each request returns up to 50 results, so use offset=50, 100, ... to page.

output.description: A list of earnings results

get_earnings_calendar_list.title: Get a list of all available companies in the earnings calendar
get_earnings_calendar_list.description: Returns the list of companies covered by the earnings calendar. For a specific company's earnings results and reporting dates use get_earnings_calendar.

output.description: A list of all available companies

get_upcoming_earnings.title: Get upcoming earnings dates with filtering
get_upcoming_earnings.description: Returns a list of upcoming earnings dates with filtering capabilities. You can filter by date range, single date, exchange, or ticker symbol. Results are limited to dates from today onwards. Premium only.
get_upcoming_earnings.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today or later. Defaults to today if not provided.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after start_date. Defaults to 10 years from today if not provided.

date.description: Single date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If provided, overrides start_date and end_date to filter by this exact date.

exchange.description: Exchange code to filter by (e.g., NASDAQ, NYSE, HKSE, LSE, TSX). Returns only earnings from companies listed on the specified exchange.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol to filter by (e.g., AAPL, 0700.HK). Returns only earnings for that specific company.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 100 (inclusive). Default is 100.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Must be a non-negative integer. Use in combination with limit to paginate through results.

output.description: A list of upcoming earnings

get_earnings_transcript.title: Get Earnings Call Transcript
get_earnings_transcript.description: Returns the full text of one company's earnings call. Requires a `ticker` or `cik`; to find which calls exist first, use search_earnings_transcripts. Choosing a `quarter` requires premium.
get_earnings_transcript.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 320193). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

year.description: Earnings year (e.g., 2025). Must be a valid year between 2000 and the current year. If provided, quarter must also be provided. Premium only.

quarter.description: Earnings quarter from Q1 to Q4. If provided, year must also be provided. Premium only.

output.description: Get Earnings Call Transcript: the JSON response.

list_earnings_call_transcripts.title: List All Earnings Call Transcripts
list_earnings_call_transcripts.description: Lists all available earnings call transcripts, paged with `limit` and `offset`. To filter by ticker, CIK or date use search_earnings_transcripts; for the text of one call use get_earnings_transcript.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Default is unlimited - all results will be returned.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default: 0.

output.description: List All Earnings Call Transcripts: the JSON response.

search_earnings_transcripts.title: Search earnings transcripts
search_earnings_transcripts.description: Finds which earnings call transcripts are available by ticker, CIK, date or date range, with paginated results. Returns the matching calls, not their text; read that from get_earnings_transcript.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., MSFT). At least one of ticker, cik, date, or start_date/end_date must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 789019). For US companies registered with the SEC only.

date.description: Earnings call date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2024-05-02). Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: Start of the earnings call date range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Must be paired with end_date. When ticker and cik are both omitted, the range cannot exceed 30 days.

end_date.description: End of the earnings call date range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Must be paired with start_date.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20; values above 200 are clamped to 200.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default 0.

output.description: Search for available earnings call transcripts by ticker, CIK, date, or date range, with paginated results: the JSON response.

get_earnings_call_speaker.title: Get earnings call speaker
get_earnings_call_speaker.description: Searches earnings-call speakers by name, company, analyst firm, role or type, or returns one speaker's profile, coverage and appearance history when `id` is given.

id.description: Resolved speaker_id. When provided, the endpoint returns that single speaker's profile, per-company coverage, and appearance history (detail mode). Search filters are ignored in detail mode, except ticker/year/quarter (which filter the appearance list) and limit/offset (which paginate it).

name.description: Substring match on the speaker's name (search mode).

company.description: Substring match on an executive's primary company (search mode).

analyst_firm.description: Substring match on an analyst's firm (search mode).

ticker.description: In search mode, restrict to people who appeared on this company's calls. In detail mode, filter the appearance list to this company.

year.description: Filter by fiscal year.

quarter.description: Filter by fiscal quarter (1-4). In search mode, requires year.

sort_dir.description: Sort direction (search mode). Defaults to desc, or asc when sort_by=name.

include_appearances.description: When true (search mode), include each returned speaker's appearance list.

limit.description: Search mode: speakers per page (default 25, max 100). Detail mode: appearances per page (default 50, max 200).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default 0.

output.description: A speaker search result (no id) or a single speaker detail object (id provided).

get_earnings_call_participants.title: List the executives and analysts who appeared on a company's earnings calls
get_earnings_call_participants.description: Lists the executives and analysts who appeared on one company's earnings calls. Requires a `ticker` or `cik`. For a single person across companies use get_earnings_call_speaker.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g. 320193). Either ticker or cik must be provided.

speaker_type.description: Restrict to the management roster (executive) or the covering analysts (analyst).

sort_dir.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc, or asc when sort_by=name.

limit.description: Maximum number of participants to return. Default 50; values above 200 are clamped to 200.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default 0.

output.description: List the executives and analysts who appeared on a company's earnings calls: the JSON response.

get_earnings.title: Get earnings report data (returns an array; query by company or by filing date)
get_earnings.description: Returns reported earnings results, filtered by `ticker`, `cik`, `year`, `quarter` or filing `date`. For dates of upcoming reports use get_earnings_calendar.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., ADBE). Use ticker or cik to query a company, or query by date with no ticker.

cik.description: Company Central Index Key (e.g., 796343). Alternative to ticker for identifying a company.

period.description: Fiscal period (q1, q2, q3, q4, or fy). Requires a ticker/cik and year.

quarter.description: Fiscal quarter 1-4 (alternative to period). Requires ticker/cik and year.

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g. 2024). With a ticker and no period/quarter, returns every period for that year; with period/quarter, one filing. Free accounts: current year only. Paid accounts: the last 5 fiscal years. Data older than 5 fiscal years requires a Business, Professional, Enterprise, or annual subscription.

get_euribor_rates.description: Returns current Euribor interbank lending rates for maturities from 1 week to 12 months. Takes no parameters.

get_executive_compensation.description: Returns named-executive-officer compensation for a company, sourced from SEC DEF 14A proxy statements, plus the structured Pay Versus Performance disclosure. get_current_gold_price.title: Get current gold futures price

calculate_income_tax.title: Calculates detailed tax information based on income, location, and filing status

get_income_tax.description: Returns comprehensive income tax information including tax brackets and rates at both federal and state/provincial levels (where applicable).

get_current_inflation.title: Get current inflation data
get_current_inflation.description: Get current inflation data. Returns current monthly and annual inflation percentages. Premium subscribers only.

get_sales_tax_filing.title: Get sales tax filing
get_sales_tax_filing.description: PREMIUM ONLY - Business tier and above; requests below that return an error. Filing frequencies and due dates for 47 US sales tax jurisdictions. Calendars are GENERATED from each state's published rules, so they stay correct across years rather than rotting like a hand-entered table. Handles what a naive 'due on the 20th' model gets wrong: due days ranging from the 15th (Maine) to the last day of the month (California); New York's quarters ending Feb/May/Aug/Nov; weekend and holiday rollover against federal, state or both calendars, flagged with due_date_adjusted and preserving statutory_due_date; electronic payments that must be INITIATED a business day early (Florida); and prepayment regimes in the four distinct placements states actually use. Supply annual_liability to have the state's own ladder assign a frequency. Where a state grants frequency by written approval or departmental notice rather than by a published dollar threshold, the response is 'indeterminate' rather than a guess. Each jurisdiction carries coverage_level, and any field the state does not publish is listed in unpublished with an unpublished_reason. State-level filing regimes only; home-rule localities that file separately are out of scope. This is reference data, not tax advice.
get_sales_tax_filing.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

state.description: Two-letter US state code or full state name (e.g. TX or Texas). Omit for all jurisdictions.

frequency.description: Filing frequency tier, e.g. monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, monthly_accelerated. Returns the generated calendar for that tier.

year.description: Four-digit calendar year for the generated calendar. Defaults to the current year.

annual_liability.description: Annual sales tax liability in US dollars. Returns the frequency the state would assign, or 'indeterminate' where the state publishes no computable threshold.

output.description: Filing rules and generated due-date calendar.

get_sales_tax_holidays.title: US sales tax holidays: dates, eligible categories and price caps
get_sales_tax_holidays.description: Sales tax holidays for US states, with timezone-aware start and end timestamps, eligible item categories and per-item price caps. Supply a date, category and amount to get an exemption determination for a single purchase. Where a state lets each locality opt in or out, the endpoint returns exempt: null with determination: 'indeterminate' and a required_input array rather than a flat true, because participation is not decidable from the state alone. Price caps are per item in most states, not per transaction; cap_basis says which. Asking for a year the state has not yet published returns an empty result set with a coverage note, not an error and not last year's dates. This is reference data, not tax advice.

output.description: Matching sales tax holidays.

get_sales_tax_nexus.title: Get sales tax nexus
get_sales_tax_nexus.description: PREMIUM ONLY - requests on the free tier return an error. Returns economic nexus thresholds for US states. Call it with no sales figures as a reference lookup, or supply sales figures to get a determination. Omit the state parameter to evaluate all 50 states and DC in one call. Any 'nexus' or 'no_nexus' determination is provable from the figures supplied. Where the inputs cannot settle the question, the endpoint returns 'indeterminate' with a required_input array rather than guessing, because states measure different quantities: taxable sales are a subset of retail sales, which are a subset of gross sales. Economic nexus only. Physical presence is not evaluated. This is reference data, not tax advice.
get_sales_tax_nexus.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

output.description: Look up carrier, line type, and network metadata for a phone number: the JSON response.

get_url_info.title: Lookup location information for a URL
get_url_info.description: Returns location information for a URL or domain name, including coordinates, city, country, and ISP details. Requires a `url`, with or without a scheme.

url.description: Valid URL to check. It supports schemes (e.g. http://example.com) as well as schemeless (e.g. example.com) formats.

output.description: Lookup location information for a URL: the JSON response.

parse_user_agent.title: Parse User Agent String
parse_user_agent.description: Parses a user agent string to extract device, OS, and browser information. All response fields are top-level. A version newer than the latest known release is reported in warnings rather than treated as invalid.

output.description: Parse result. Check is_valid; when false, invalid_reason explains why, and the parsed fields are still populated where possible.

generate_user_agent.title: Generate User Agent String
generate_user_agent.description: Generates a user agent string, optionally matching a device `brand`, `model`, `os` and `browser`. To parse an existing user agent string instead use parse_user_agent.

output.description: Generate User Agent String: the JSON response.

validate_email.title: Validate an email address
validate_email.description: Checks whether an `email` address is syntactically valid and has a deliverable mail domain. For disposable-address detection use check_disposable_email.

output.description: Validate an email address: the JSON response.

validate_phone.title: Validate a phone number and get its metadata
validate_phone.description: Validates a phone `number` and returns its normalised format, country and location. For carrier and line type use phone_lookup.

number.description: Phone number to check. The leading '+' is optional. If country is not set, include the country code (e.g. 12065550100 or +12065550100).

country.description: 2-letter ISO-3166 country code the phone number belongs to.

output.description: Validate a phone number and get its metadata: the JSON response.

scrape_webpage.title: Scrape data from a specified URL
scrape_webpage.description: Fetches a `url` and returns its contents, with `text_only` to strip markup. For the page title and metadata alone use get_webpage_metadata.

text_only.description: Whether to only extract visible text (ignores HTML tags and metadata).

user_agent.description: User-Agent string to use in the request header.

output.description: Scrape data from a specified URL: the JSON response.

get_webpage_metadata.title: Retrieve web page metadata
get_webpage_metadata.description: Retrieve web page metadata. Returns the URL information and web page metadata from a given URL.

output.description: Retrieve web page metadata: the JSON response.

get_whois.title: Get domain registration details
get_whois.description: Returns WHOIS registration details for a `domain`, including registrar, creation and expiry dates. For risk and email-provider signals use get_domain_info.

domain.description: Valid domain to check (e.g. example.com). For top-level domains other than .com, a premium subscription is required.

output.description: Get domain registration details: the JSON response.

get_air_quality.title: Get air quality by city or location coordinates
get_air_quality.description: Returns the Air Quality Index plus CO, NO2, O3, SO2, PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations for a location. Requires a `city` or `lat`/`lon`; `state` and `country` disambiguate city names.

city.description: City name.

state.description: US state (for United States cities only).

country.description: Country name.

output.description: Get air quality by city or location coordinates: the JSON response.

get_city_data.title: Get city data
get_city_data.description: Get city data from either a name or population range. Returns a list of cities that satisfies the parameters.

name.description: Name of city.

country.description: Country filter. Must be an ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US).

limit.description: How many results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 1. To get more than 30 results, use the offset parameter. Premium only.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Premium only.

output.description: A list of cities matching the query.

get_all_country_flags.title: List flag URLs for all supported countries (premium only)
get_all_country_flags.description: Returns flag image URLs for every supported country, territory and area. For one country's flag as a base64 SVG use get_country_flag. Requires a premium subscription.
get_all_country_flags.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

output.description: List flag URLs for all supported countries (premium only): the JSON response.

get_country_flag.title: Get a country's flag as an SVG image in base64 format
get_country_flag.description: Returns one country's flag as a base64-encoded SVG image. Requires a 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 `country` code. For URLs of all supported flags use get_all_country_flags.

country.description: 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, CA, FR). For countries in the United Kingdom, use GB for Great Britain, GB-ENG for England, GB-SCT for Scotland, GB-WLS for Wales, GB-NIR for Northern Ireland.

output.description: Get a country's flag as an SVG image in base64 format: the JSON response.

get_all_countries.title: List 2-letter ISO country codes for all supported countries (premium only)
get_all_countries.description: Returns the 2-letter ISO codes of every supported country. For statistics about a specific country use get_country_data. Requires a premium subscription.
get_all_countries.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

output.description: List 2-letter ISO country codes for all supported countries (premium only): the JSON response.

get_country_data.title: Get country data from given parameters
get_country_data.description: Returns geographic, demographic, and economic statistics for countries matching filters such as name, currency, GDP, population, area, or unemployment rate.

name.description: Plain English name, 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2, or 3-letter ISO-3166 alpha-3 code of country.

min_gdp.description: Minimum gross domestic product (GDP) of country, in US Dollars.

max_gdp.description: Maximum gross domestic product (GDP) of country, in US Dollars.

min_area.description: Minimum surface area of country in km2.

max_area.description: Maximum surface area of country in km2.

min_infant_mortality.description: Minimum infant mortality rate per 1,000 live births.

max_infant_mortality.description: Maximum infant mortality rate per 1,000 live births.

min_fertility.description: Minimum fertility rate (average number of children per woman).

max_fertility.description: Maximum fertility rate (average number of children per woman).

limit.description: How many results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 5.

output.description: A list of country statistics.

get_county.title: Get County Information
get_county.description: Get County Information. Returns details for one or more counties matching the input parameters.

county.description: Full name of the county to search.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 1.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Default is 0.

output.description: Get County Information: the JSON response.

get_gdp_data.title: Get GDP data
get_gdp_data.description: Get GDP data from given parameters. Returns GDP statistics that satisfy the parameters.

country.description: Country name (case-insensitive) or 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 code of the country. E.g. Canada or CA.

year.description: Year for which to retrieve GDP data.

output.description: Get GDP data: the JSON response.

get_geocoding.title: Get coordinates for a city, state, or US ZIP code
get_geocoding.description: Converts a place name into latitude and longitude. Requires `city`; narrow with `state`, `country` or `zipcode`. For the reverse direction use get_reverse_geocoding.

city.description: City name.

state.description: US state (for United States cities only).

country.description: Country name, 2-letter ISO country code, or 3-letter ISO country code.

output.description: Get coordinates for a city, state, or US ZIP code: the JSON response.

get_reverse_geocoding.title: Convert latitude/longitude coordinates to city locations
get_reverse_geocoding.description: Converts a `lat` and `lon` pair into the matching place name and administrative area. For the opposite direction use get_geocoding.

output.description: A list of cities that contain the given latitude and longitude.

get_population_data.title: Get population data
get_population_data.description: Get population data from given parameters. Returns a list of up to 5 country population statistics that satisfy the parameters. For more results use the offset parameter.

country.description: Country name (case-insensitive) or 2-letter ISO-3166 alpha-2 code of the country. E.g. Japan or JP.

offset.description: Offset results for pagination.

output.description: Get population data: the JSON response.

get_postal_code.title: Get postal code information
get_postal_code.description: Returns details for a Canadian postal code, given as A1A1A1 or A1A 1A1. Searching by `city` and `province` instead of a postal code requires premium.
get_postal_code.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

postal_code.description: The postal code to look up. Accepts Canadian postal codes in 6 characters (A1A1A1) or 7 characters with a space (A1A 1A1). The space will be automatically normalized if not provided.

city.description: Full name of the city to search (case-sensitive). Premium only.

province.description: 2-letter abbreviation of the province (e.g., ON, BC, QC). Premium only.

output.description: Get postal code information: the JSON response.

get_timezone.title: Get timezone info by city/state/country or location coordinates
get_timezone.description: Returns the IANA timezone and current local time for a location given as `lat`/`lon`, `city`, or an explicit `timezone` name.

city.description: City name.

state.description: US state (for United States cities only).

country.description: Country name.

output.description: Get timezone info by city/state/country or location coordinates: the JSON response.

get_current_weather.title: Get current weather data
get_current_weather.description: Get current weather, wind speed and direction, humidity, and temperature data by city, ZIP code, or geolocation coordinates (latitude/longitude). One of the following parameter combinations must be provided: lat and lon; or city, state (optional), and country (optional).

zip.description: 5 digit Zip code (United States only). Premium subscribers only.

city.description: City name. Premium subscribers only.

state.description: US state (for United States cities only). Premium subscribers only.

country.description: Country name. Premium subscribers only.

output.description: Get current weather data: the JSON response.

get_weather_forecast.title: Get a 5-day weather forecast in 3-hour intervals
get_weather_forecast.description: Returns a 5-day weather forecast in 3-hour intervals for a given city. One of the following parameter combinations must be provided: lat and lon; zip; or city, state (optional), and country (optional).

zip.description: 5 digit Zip code (United States only). Premium subscribers only.

city.description: City name. Premium subscribers only.

state.description: US state (for United States cities only). Premium subscribers only.

country.description: Country name. Premium subscribers only.

output.description: A JSON array of weather forecast entries with the same fields as the Weather Response.

get_weather_icons.title: Get the complete weather icon catalog (Premium only)
get_weather_icons.description: Returns every light/dark SVG and 64/128/256-pixel PNG URL for the 74 icons, plus all 55 condition-code mappings. Requires an authenticated paid API Ninjas subscription; normal Weather API quotas apply. No anonymous demo access. No parameters required.
get_weather_icons.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

output.description: The complete catalog of 592 public image URLs.

get_working_days.title: Get working and non-working days
get_working_days.description: Returns the working and non-working days for a country across a year or a single month, with configurable weekends. Requires `country`. For one date use is_working_day.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code.

year.description: Calendar year between 1980 and 2050 (inclusive). By default, the current year is used.

month.description: Month number (1-12). If provided, returns data for just that month.

weekend.description: Comma-separated list of weekend days (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun).

public_holidays.description: Whether to include public holidays as non-working days (true/false). Defaults to true.

output.description: Get working and non-working days: the JSON response.

is_working_day.title: Check if a specific date is a working day
is_working_day.description: Reports whether one specific date is a working day in a given country. Requires `country` and `date`. For a whole month or year use get_working_days.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be between 1980-01-01 and 2050-12-31 (inclusive).

public_holidays.description: Whether to include public holidays as non-working days (true/false). Defaults to true.

output.description: Check if a specific date is a working day: the JSON response.

get_world_time.title: Get the current date and time
get_world_time.description: Get the current date and time by city/state/country, location coordinates (latitude/longitude), or timezone.

lat.description: Latitude of desired location. Premium subscribers only.

lon.description: Longitude of desired location. Premium subscribers only.

city.description: City name. Premium subscribers only.

state.description: US state (for United States cities only). Premium subscribers only.

country.description: Country name. Premium subscribers only.

output.description: Get the current date and time: the JSON response.

get_zip_code.title: Get ZIP Code details
get_zip_code.description: Get ZIP Code details. Returns a list of ZIP Code details matching the input parameters.

zip.description: The ZIP Code to look up.

city.description: Full name of the city to search (case-sensitive). Premium subscribers only.

state.description: 2-letter abbreviation of the state (case-insensitive). Premium subscribers only.

output.description: Get ZIP Code details: the JSON response.

get_aircraft.title: Get aircraft details
get_aircraft.description: Get aircraft details. Returns a list of aircrafts that match the given parameters.

manufacturer.description: Company that designed and built the aircraft.

engine_type.description: Type of engine. Must be one of: piston, propjet, jet.

min_speed.description: Minimum max. air speed in knots.

max_speed.description: Maximum max. air speed in knots.

min_range.description: Minimum range of the aircraft in nautical miles.

max_range.description: Maximum range of the aircraft in nautical miles.

min_length.description: Minimum length of the aircraft in feet.

max_length.description: Maximum length of the aircraft in feet.

min_height.description: Minimum height of the aircraft in feet.

max_height.description: Maximum height of the aircraft in feet.

min_wingspan.description: Minimum wingspan of the aircraft in feet.

max_wingspan.description: Maximum wingspan of the aircraft in feet.

limit.description: How many results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 1.

output.description: Get aircraft details: the JSON response.

get_airlines.title: Get general and detailed fleet information for airlines
get_airlines.description: Returns general and fleet information for airlines matching an ICAO code, IATA code, or name. At least one of `icao`, `iata`, or `name` must be set.

icao.description: International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) 3-character airline code. At least one of icao, iata, or name must be set.

iata.description: International Air Transport Association (IATA) 2-character airline code. At least one of icao, iata, or name must be set.

name.description: Airline name. This parameter supports partial matching (e.g. United will match United Airlines). At least one of icao, iata, or name must be set.

output.description: A list of up to 10 airline results.

get_airports.title: Get airport information
get_airports.description: Returns airports matching filters such as IATA/ICAO code, name, city, country, region, elevation, size, or runway length. For typeahead suggestions use airport_suggest.

iata.description: International Air Transport Association (IATA) airport code (typically 3 characters). Supports partial, case-insensitive matching (substring search).

icao.description: International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) airport code (typically 4 characters). Supports partial, case-insensitive matching (substring search).

name.description: Airport name. Supports partial matching (substring search). Premium only.

country.description: Airport country. Must be 2-character ISO-2 country code. Premium only.

region.description: Administrative region such as state or province within a country. Supports partial, case-insensitive matching (substring search). Premium only.

city.description: Airport city. Supports partial, case-insensitive matching (substring search). Premium only.

min_elevation.description: Minimum airport elevation in feet. Premium only.

max_elevation.description: Maximum airport elevation in feet. Premium only.

has_iata.description: Filter by whether the airport has an IATA code. Premium only.

min_runway_length.description: Minimum length (in feet) of at least one runway at the airport. Premium only.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 100. Default is 10. Premium only.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Default is passengers. Premium only.

order.description: Sort direction. Default is desc. Premium only.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Premium only.

output.description: A list of airports.

get_airports_list.title: Get a list of airport codes and names. Premium only
get_airports_list.description: Returns a paginated list of airport codes and names. For filtered airport detail use get_airports. Requires a premium subscription.
get_airports_list.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination. Default is 0. Premium only.

output.description: A list of airport codes and names.

convert_airport_code.title: Convert between IATA and ICAO airport codes. Premium only
convert_airport_code.description: Converts an airport code between IATA and ICAO. Pass exactly one of `iata`, `icao`, or `code` (auto-detected). Requires a premium subscription.
convert_airport_code.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

iata.description: 3-character IATA airport code. Exactly one of iata, icao, or code must be provided.

icao.description: 4-character ICAO airport code. Exactly one of iata, icao, or code must be provided.

code.description: Auto-detected IATA (3 chars) or ICAO (4 chars) code. Exactly one of iata, icao, or code must be provided.

output.description: The matched airport's details.

airport_distance.title: Airport distance
airport_distance.description: Calculates great-circle distance, initial bearing, and estimated flight time between two airports. Requires `from` and `to`. Requires a premium subscription.
airport_distance.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

from.description: Origin airport - IATA (3 chars) or ICAO (4 chars) code.

to.description: Destination airport - IATA (3 chars) or ICAO (4 chars) code.

output.description: Distance, bearing, and estimated flight time between the two airports.

airport_suggest.title: Airport suggest
airport_suggest.description: Returns autocomplete suggestions for airport search, matching IATA, ICAO, name, and city. Requires a `q` of at least 2 characters. Requires a premium subscription.
airport_suggest.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

q.description: Query string. Must be at least 2 characters.

country.description: Restrict results to a country. Must be a 2-character ISO country code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 3. Default is 3.

output.description: A list of compact airport records ranked by match quality and size.

closest_airport.title: Closest airport
closest_airport.description: Returns the airports nearest a coordinate, sorted by airport size then by distance. Requires `lat` and `lon`. Requires a premium subscription.
closest_airport.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, in decimal degrees.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center, in decimal degrees.

radius.description: Search radius in kilometres. Default is 50, maximum is 500.

has_iata.description: Filter by whether the airport has an IATA code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 50. Default is 10.

output.description: A list of nearby airports sorted by size (largest first) then by distance ascending.

search_cars.title: Search cars
search_cars.description: The main endpoint. Search the whole catalogue by any combination of filters, or fetch cars you already know with id/ids. At least one filter, or an id, is required. The total number of matches is returned in the X-Total-Count response header. Requires a paid plan (Premium).
search_cars.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

max_year.description: Cars in production in or before this year.

year.description: Cars in production in this year. A filter, not a starting point.

limit.description: How many results to return, between 1 and 100. Default 10 -- each car carries a full specification sheet of roughly 2 KB. A value outside the range is rejected rather than silently clamped.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination. Default 0.

get_car_facets.description: Builds every dependent dropdown in one request instead of one request per level. Facets narrow with whatever is already selected. Available on every plan, including Free.

make.description: Manufacturer, as a word. Case and punctuation are ignored, so bmw, BMW and Bmw all resolve.

model.description: Model, as a word. '3 Series', '3-series' and '3series' all resolve.

year.description: Cars in production in this year.

year.description: Only manufacturers with a car in production in this year.

limit.description: How many results to return, between 1 and 100. Default 30. A value outside that range is rejected rather than silently clamped.

list_car_models.title: List models for a manufacturer. Premium only
list_car_models.description: Lists the models belonging to a given manufacturer. Pair with list_car_makes upstream and list_car_generations downstream. Requires a paid plan (Premium).

search_cocktails.title: Search cocktail recipes
search_cocktails.description: Searches cocktail recipes by name, with partial matches, or by a comma-separated ingredient list that returns only drinks containing every listed ingredient.

get_covid_data.title: Get Covid-19 case count or death data
get_covid_data.description: Returns Covid-19 case counts or deaths by country, administrative region, or US county, as a series or a single-day snapshot. Either `date` or `country` must be set.

get_exercises.title: Get exercises

name.description: Name of exercise. This value can be partial.

muscle.description: Muscle group targeted by the exercise.

get_all_exercises.title: Get all exercises for a muscle group

muscle.description: Muscle group targeted by the exercise.

get_hospitals.title: Get hospital data based on given parameters
get_hospitals.description: Returns US hospitals matching a name, city, state, ZIP code, county or latitude/longitude bounding box, with location, contact information and bed count.

name.description: Name of the hospital to search for. Supports partial matching.

city.description: City where the hospital is located.

state.description: State where the hospital is located.

zipcode.description: ZIP code of the hospital location.

county.description: County where the hospital is located.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Default is 5. Maximum is 100.

get_nutrition.title: Get nutrition information from text

get_nutrition_item.title: Get nutrition information for a single food item with a specific quantity
get_nutrition_item.description: Returns nutrition data for a single food item at a stated amount. Requires `query` and `quantity` such as "1 cup". For free-form text with several foods use get_nutrition.

get_nutrition_barcode.title: Get nutrition information for a branded/packaged food by barcode
get_nutrition_barcode.description: Look up nutrition, allergens, and ingredients for a branded/packaged food product by its UPC/EAN barcode. Requires a Business plan or above.

upc.description: The UPC/EAN barcode of the product to look up.

get_recipes.title: Get a list of recipes
get_recipes.description: Get a list of recipes for a given recipe name or ingredient(s). Returns a list of recipes with nutrition information when available. ingredients.description: Comma-separated list of ingredients to search for. Premium subscribers only.

compute_text_similarity.title: Compute text similarity score

generate_lorem_ipsum.title: Generate Lorem Ipsum Text
generate_lorem_ipsum.description: Generate Lorem Ipsum Text. Returns one or more paragraphs of lorem ipsum placeholder text.

filter_profanity.title: Detects and censors profanity in text

get_random_word.title: Returns a random word

get_rhymes.title: Get rhyming words

detect_language.title: Detects the language of the given text

get_thesaurus.title: Get synonyms and antonyms for a word
get_thesaurus.description: Returns the synonyms (similar words) and antonyms (opposite meanings) of a single English word. Requires a `word` to look up.

output.description: Get synonyms and antonyms for a word: the JSON response.

get_animals.title: Retrieve information about animals
get_animals.description: Returns scientific facts about animal species whose common name matches the search term, including partial matches. Requires `name`.

get_cats.title: Get a list of cat breeds matching specified parameters
get_cats.description: Returns cat breeds matching the given parameters, including weight, life expectancy, shedding, grooming and friendliness traits. For breed names only use get_all_cat_names.

get_all_cat_names.title: Returns a list of all cat breed names

get_dogs.title: Get a list of dog breeds matching specified parameters
get_dogs.description: Returns dog breeds matching filters such as name, height, weight, life expectancy, shedding, barking, energy, or trainability. For breed names only use get_all_dogs.

name.description: The name of breed.

get_horoscope.description: Returns the daily horoscope for one zodiac sign. An optional `date` in YYYY-MM-DD format gives a past day's horoscope; future dates are not accepted.

type.description: Filter results to a single holiday type. Accepts one of the enumerated values, e.g. `public_holiday` for nationally mandated days off. Omit to return every type.

output.description: A list of holiday entries for the specified country and year.

is_holiday.title: Get all holidays that fall on a given date
is_holiday.description: Returns all holidays that fall on a given date, optionally restricted to one country. Requires a `date`. For a full year's calendar use get_holidays.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2025-12-25). Note: dates in future calendar years are for premium subscribers only.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-2 country code (preferred). If not specified, holidays from all countries are returned.

output.description: A list of holiday entries matching the specified date.

get_logos.title: Get company logos
get_logos.description: Get a list of company names, ticker symbols, and logo image URLs matching the input parameters. Returns at most 10 results.

name.description: Company name. Supports partial matching (e.g. 'Micro' will match 'Microsoft'). Case-insensitive.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (for publicly traded companies only).

output.description: A list of company logos.

search_planets.title: Get a list of planets
search_planets.description: Get a list of planets matching specified parameters. Returns at most 30 results. To access more than 30 results, use the offset parameter to offset results in multiple API calls.

name.description: The name of the planet.

min_mass.description: Minimum mass of the planet in Jupiters.

max_mass.description: Maximum mass of the planet in Jupiters.

min_radius.description: Minimum average radius of the planet in Jupiters.

max_radius.description: Maximum average radius of the planet in Jupiters.

min_period.description: Minimum orbital period of the planet in Earth days.

max_period.description: Maximum orbital period of the planet in Earth days.

min_temperature.description: Minimum average surface temperature of the planet in Kelvin.

max_temperature.description: Maximum average surface temperature of the planet in Kelvin.

min_distance_light_year.description: Minimum distance the planet is from Earth in light years.

max_distance_light_year.description: Maximum distance the planet is from Earth in light years.

min_semi_major_axis.description: Minimum semi major axis of planet in astronomical units (AU).

max_semi_major_axis.description: Maximum semi major axis of planet in astronomical units (AU).

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination.

output.description: A list of planets

get_public_holidays.title: Get public holidays for a given country and year
get_public_holidays.description: Returns public holidays for a country and calendar year. Requires a `country`. To test whether one date is a public holiday use is_public_holiday.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code or full country name.

year.description: Calendar year between 1980 and 2050 (inclusive). Defaults to current year. Premium only.

output.description: A list of public holidays

is_public_holiday.title: Check if a given date is a public holiday for a given country
is_public_holiday.description: Checks whether a given date is a public holiday in a country. Requires `country` and `date`. For a whole year of public holidays use get_public_holidays.

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be between 1980-01-01 and 2050-12-31 (inclusive).

output.description: Public holiday information

get_random_users.title: Get fake random user profiles
get_random_users.description: Generates fake user profiles such as name, email, address and username for testing or placeholders, with count, gender, age, locale, field selection and seed options.

locale.description: Locale for generating localized data (e.g., en_US, de_DE, fr_FR)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include. If not specified, all available fields are returned.

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from the response

seed.description: Seed value for reproducible random data generation

blank_percentage.description: Percentage of fields to leave blank (0-100)

output.description: Get fake random user profiles: the JSON response.

search_stars.title: Get a list of stars
search_stars.description: Get a list of stars matching specified parameters. Returns at most 30 results. To access more than 30 results, use the offset parameter to offset results in multiple API calls.

name.description: The name of the star.

constellation.description: The constellation that the star belongs to.

min_apparent_magnitude.description: Minimum apparent magnitude brightness of the star.

max_apparent_magnitude.description: Maximum apparent magnitude brightness of the star.

min_absolute_magnitude.description: Minimum absolute magnitude brightness of the star.

max_absolute_magnitude.description: Maximum absolute magnitude brightness of the star.

min_distance_light_year.description: Minimum distance the star is from Earth in light years.

max_distance_light_year.description: Maximum distance the star is from Earth in light years.

offset.description: Number of results to offset for pagination.

output.description: A list of stars

convert_unit.title: Converts between different units of measurement
convert_unit.description: Converts a numeric value from one unit of measurement to another. Requires `amount` and the source `unit`, with spaces written as underscores.

unit.description: The source unit to convert from. Spaces should be replaced with underscores.

output.description: Converts between different units of measurement: the JSON response.

get_universities.title: Get information about universities
get_universities.description: Returns universities in the United States and Canada matching a name or country. Filters for city, state, enrollment, faculty ratio, and tuition are premium only.
get_universities.notes: Parts of this endpoint need a paid API Ninjas plan; see the description and argument notes.

name.description: The name of the university to search for. Can be a partial match (e.g., "Harvard" will match "Harvard University"). At least one filter parameter (excluding offset/limit) must be provided.

country.description: The country to filter by. Must be USA or Canada (case-insensitive). At least one filter parameter (excluding offset/limit) must be provided.

city.description: The city where the university is located. Premium only.

state.description: The state or province where the university is located. Premium only.

min_faculty_ratio.description: Minimum student-to-faculty ratio as a number (e.g., 15 for 15:1 ratio). Premium only.

max_faculty_ratio.description: Maximum student-to-faculty ratio as a number (e.g., 20 for 20:1 ratio). Premium only.

min_enrolled.description: Minimum number of enrolled students. Premium only.

max_enrolled.description: Maximum number of enrolled students. Premium only.

min_tuition.description: Minimum annual tuition cost (in USD). Premium only.

max_tuition.description: Maximum annual tuition cost (in USD). Premium only.

offset.description: The number of results to skip. Must be zero or a positive integer. Default is 0. Premium only.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 30. Default is 10 for premium users, fixed at 5 for free users. Premium only.

output.description: Get information about universities: the JSON response.
